title: Numbers 19:6-7 — cedar, hyssop and scarlet cast into the burning heifer
summary: Numbers 19:6-7 in English: the priest takes cedar wood, hyssop and scarlet material and casts them into the burning heifer, then washes his clothes and bathes in water, and remains unclean until evening. Key words (cedar wood, hyssop, scarlet, heifer, water, unclean) are shown in different colours.

text.text: 6 ‘The priest shall take cedar wood and hyssop and scarlet material and cast it into the midst of the burning heifer.
7 ‘The priest shall then wash his clothes and bathe his body in water, and afterward come into the camp, but the priest shall be unclean until evening.

keywords: wash clothes and bathe in water
